WindowsPage.title: Window Systems
WindowsPage.description: Premium window solutions engineered for energy efficiency, durability, and modern aesthetics. From classic double hung to contemporary casement designs.
WindowsPage.ourWindowsDesc: Explore our complete range of high-performance window systems.
WindowsPage.typeTopHungDesc: Hinged at the top and opening outward from the bottom. Ideal for ventilation while preventing rain entry.
WindowsPage.typeSlidingDesc: Horizontal sliding sash windows that glide smoothly on precision tracks. Space-efficient and easy to operate.
WindowsPage.typeAwningDesc: Hinged at the top with the sash swinging outward. Excellent for ventilation even in rainy conditions.
WindowsPage.typeCasementDesc: Side-hinged windows that open outward. Maximum ventilation and unobstructed views with superior energy performance.
WindowsPage.typeTiltTurnDesc: European-style windows that tilt inward from the top for ventilation or swing fully inward for easy cleaning.
WindowsPage.typeHandCrankedDesc: Traditional casement operated by a hand crank mechanism. Precise control with outward projection for maximum airflow.
WindowsPage.ctaDesc: Visualize different window styles, frame colors, and glass types in our interactive 3D tool.

DoorsPage.title: Door Systems
DoorsPage.description: Professional door solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial applications. Sliding patio doors, commercial entry systems, and industrial overhead doors.
DoorsPage.ourDoorsDesc: Explore our complete range of high-performance door systems.
DoorsPage.typeSlidingDesc: Large-panel doors that glide horizontally on precision tracks. Available in 2, 3, and 4-panel configurations for seamless indoor-outdoor flow.
DoorsPage.typeFoldingDesc: Multi-panel bi-fold systems that fold and stack to create wide open passages. Transform entire walls into open-air spaces.
DoorsPage.typeSwingDesc: Traditional hinged doors that swing open on side-mounted hinges. Available as single or double-leaf, inward or outward opening.
DoorsPage.ctaDesc: Our experts can help you choose the perfect door system for your project requirements.

casement-windows.name: Casement Windows
casement-windows.description: Premium casement windows with multi-point locking systems and superior weather sealing. Ideal for residential and light commercial applications with maximum ventilation and unobstructed views.
casement-windows.shortDescription: Energy-efficient casement windows with superior ventilation and modern aesthetics.

sliding-patio-doors.name: Sliding Patio Doors
sliding-patio-doors.description: Smooth-operating sliding patio doors with premium rollers, multi-point locks, and thermal break frames. Perfect for connecting indoor and outdoor living spaces.
sliding-patio-doors.shortDescription: Premium sliding doors for seamless indoor-outdoor transitions.

double-hung-windows.name: Double Hung Windows
double-hung-windows.description: Classic double hung windows with tilt-in sashes for easy cleaning. Features warm edge spacers, argon gas fill, and optional grille patterns.
double-hung-windows.shortDescription: Traditional double hung windows with modern performance features.

storefront-systems.name: Storefront Systems
storefront-systems.description: Commercial-grade storefront glazing systems designed for retail, office, and institutional buildings. Features thermally broken aluminum frames and high-performance glazing.
storefront-systems.shortDescription: Professional storefront systems for commercial applications.

curtain-wall-systems.name: Curtain Wall Systems
curtain-wall-systems.description: Architectural curtain wall systems for mid-rise and high-rise buildings. Engineered for structural performance, thermal efficiency, and aesthetic excellence.
curtain-wall-systems.shortDescription: High-performance curtain wall systems for modern architecture.

commercial-entry-systems.name: Commercial Entry Systems
commercial-entry-systems.description: Heavy-duty commercial entry door systems with panic hardware, automatic operators, and ADA compliance. Available in aluminum, steel, and glass configurations.
commercial-entry-systems.shortDescription: Durable entry systems for commercial and institutional buildings.

safety-glass-panels.name: Safety Glass Panels
safety-glass-panels.description: Industrial-grade safety glass panels including tempered, laminated, and fire-rated options. Meets all Canadian safety standards for industrial environments.
safety-glass-panels.shortDescription: Industrial safety glass solutions for demanding environments.

overhead-doors.name: Overhead Doors
overhead-doors.description: Heavy-duty overhead doors for warehouses, loading docks, and industrial facilities. Available in insulated, fire-rated, and high-speed configurations.
overhead-doors.shortDescription: Industrial overhead doors for warehouses and facilities.

installation.name: Professional Installation
installation.description: Expert installation by certified technicians. We handle everything from removal of old units to final finishing and cleanup.

measurement.name: On-Site Measurement
measurement.description: Precise on-site measurements by our trained professionals to ensure perfect fit and optimal performance.

inspection.name: Window & Door Inspection
inspection.description: Comprehensive inspection services to assess the condition of existing windows and doors, with detailed reports and recommendations.

consultation.name: Free Consultation
consultation.description: Expert advice on product selection, energy efficiency, and design options. Available in-person or virtually.

repair.name: Repair & Maintenance
repair.description: Professional repair and maintenance services to extend the life of your windows and doors. Emergency service available.

custom.name: Custom Design
custom.description: Bespoke window and door solutions tailored to your unique architectural requirements and specifications.

lakeside-villa.title: Lakeside Villa Renovation
lakeside-villa.description: Complete window replacement for a luxury lakeside property featuring floor-to-ceiling casement windows and sliding patio doors.

pinnacle-tower.title: Pinnacle Tower
pinnacle-tower.description: Curtain wall installation for a 25-story mixed-use tower in downtown Toronto, featuring high-performance glazing.

riverside-commons.title: Riverside Commons
riverside-commons.description: Multi-unit residential development with energy-efficient windows and balcony door systems for 150 units.

heritage-house.title: Heritage House Restoration
heritage-house.description: Sensitive restoration of heritage windows with modern energy-efficient replacements that maintain the original aesthetic.

skyline-business.title: Skyline Business Centre
skyline-business.description: Commercial storefront and entry system installation for a modern office complex with automated entrance systems.

autotech-manufacturing.title: AutoTech Manufacturing
autotech-manufacturing.description: Industrial safety glass and overhead door installation for a large automotive manufacturing facility.
